chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to us, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ziyad ibn Marwan al-Qandi, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Mubarak ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said:

Islam is bare. Its garment is modesty, its ornament is faithfulness, its chivalry is righteous deeds, and its pillar is piety. Everything has a foundation, and the foundation of Islam is loving us, the Ahl al-Bayt.

key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt -- the People of the House, the Prophet's household
key_terms.الحياء: Haya -- modesty, sense of shame; a quality the Prophet (SAWW) considered central to faith
key_terms.المروءة: Muru'a -- chivalry, noble character, manliness in the sense of human dignity
key_terms.الورع: Wara' -- piety, scrupulousness in avoiding the forbidden
key_terms.الوفاء: Wafa -- faithfulness, keeping promises; an essential Islamic virtue

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the foundation of Islam and the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), as transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and his forefathers, described Islam through a vivid metaphor: Islam is like a bare body that must be clothed and adorned with virtues -- modesty, faithfulness, righteous deeds, and piety. The climax of the saying is that the very foundation of Islam is love for the Ahl al-Bayt (the Prophet's household). This hadith was delivered in the context of teaching the inseparability of moral virtues from the love of the Prophet's family, a core tenet of Shia belief.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdillah narrated to us from Ya`qub b. Yazid from Ziyad b. Marwan al-Qindi from `Ali b. Mu`abbad from `Abdullah b. al-Qasim from Mubarak b. `Abd al-Rahman from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Islam is bare. Its dress is modesty, its ornament is dignity, its good deed is chivalry, and its support is piety. Everything has a foundation, and the foundation of Islam is loving us, the Ahl al-Bayt.
